newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.AFRICA'S GRINAKER AVITRONICS MERGES WITH DELCON.
newsitem.headline: S.AFRICA'S GRINAKER AVITRONICS MERGES WITH DELCON.

text.p: Grinaker Avitronics and Delcon Control Systems (Pty) Ltd said on Friday they had merged to improve their marketing of naval electronic warfare (EW) systems.

"We firmly believe that this merger will enable us to be a significant world player in the naval EW arena and we are specifically addressing the upgrade and logistical support requirements of navies that do not have indigenous EW capabilities," Grinaker Avitronics managing director Alan Holloway said in a statement.
Both Grinaker Avitronics, a division of Grinaker Electronics Ltd , and Delcon already supply the South African navy.
